propositions: Plan edits mid-review waste all remaining LLM passes because checkpoints key on material fingerprint and sign-time only rejects after all work completes
Cancel predicate must scope to own material only (not relation snapshot or related material) to avoid re-introducing d70a false cancels on unrelated ticket writes
Cancel signal must be an out-of-band token checked before recovery paths to prevent a step-failure-like cancel from being recovered into a findings verdict that flows to signing and sidecar
Probe placement at exactly two between-pass seams (after finders and after decide) detects own-material changes without per-chunk polling or whole-store reads
Cancelled reviews return unsigned INDETERMINATE verdicts with finding id plan-review-cancelled-stale before any signing or sidecar emission, mirroring not-claimable early returns
